Package org.thewhitemage13.service

Class PhoneValidationService

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.service.PhoneValidationService
All Implemented Interfaces:
PhoneValidationServiceInterface
@Service public class PhoneValidationService extends Object implements PhoneValidationServiceInterface
Service for validating and formatting phone numbers.

This service provides phone number validation and formatting functionalities. It uses the PhoneNumberUtil class from the Google libphonenumber library to validate phone numbers and ensure that they are in the correct format. It also checks whether the phone number is already in use in the system.

Key Features:

  • Validates the phone number format for a given region.
  • Formats the phone number into an international format.
  • Checks whether a phone number is already in use in the system.
  • Throws custom exceptions for invalid or already taken phone numbers.

  • Method Details

    • validatePhoneNumberForUpdate

      public String validatePhoneNumberForUpdate(String phoneNum, String region) throws com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.NumberParseException
      Validates and formats the phone number for an update.

      This method formats the phone number into an international format and checks whether the phone number is valid for the given region. If the number is not valid, it throws an IncorrectPhoneNumberException.

      Specified by:
      validatePhoneNumberForUpdate in interface PhoneValidationServiceInterface
      Parameters:
      phoneNum - the phone number to be validated and formatted
      region - the region code (e.g., "US", "RU") for phone number validation
      Returns:
      the formatted phone number in international format
      Throws:
      com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.NumberParseException - if the phone number cannot be parsed
      IncorrectPhoneNumberException - if the phone number is invalid

    • validateUniquePhoneNumber

      public String validateUniquePhoneNumber(String phoneNum, String region) throws com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.NumberParseException
      Validates the phone number format and checks for its uniqueness.

      This method checks if the phone number is already in use in the system. If the phone number is already taken, it throws an IncorrectPhoneNumberException. If the number is valid, it formats it into the international format and returns the result.

      Specified by:
      validateUniquePhoneNumber in interface PhoneValidationServiceInterface
      Parameters:
      phoneNum - the phone number to be validated and checked for uniqueness
      region - the region code (e.g., "US", "RU") for phone number validation
      Returns:
      the formatted phone number in international format
      Throws:
      com.google.i18n.phonenumbers.NumberParseException - if the phone number cannot be parsed
      IncorrectPhoneNumberException - if the phone number is invalid or already in use
